top_stories.title: AI agents inherit employee access, and nobody’s watching how they use it
top_stories.summary: A Nudge Security report finds that AI agents built by employees within project trackers, CRMs, and automation tools frequently operate using the credentials and access permissions of their creators. The "AI Adoption in Practice 2026" report is based on anonymized telemetry from Nudge Security customer environments and tracks AI tool usage, connected integrations, and running agents across organizations.

top_stories.title: Attackers Compromise Microsoft's Agent Framework PyPI Package to Steal Cloud Credentials
top_stories.summary: Threat actors compromised Microsoft's agent-framework PyPI package to distribute a credential stealer targeting cloud credentials, with malicious versions 1.26.1 and 1.26.2 published 33 minutes apart on November 17, 2026. The malicious code executes a credential stealer on every Python start, with the compromise confirmed by multiple security vendors including Aikido, Chainguard, Wiz, and others.

top_stories.title: Linx Security extends identity governance to AI agent actions
top_stories.summary: Linx Security has announced four new capabilities designed to extend identity governance to AI agent actions, covering both managed and unmanaged agents across any gateway. The features include Shadow AI Agent Detection for unsanctioned agents and Agent Runtime Control for real-time decision-making on agent actions.

top_stories.title: AWS IAM announces Access Troubleshooter to debug access denied errors
top_stories.summary: AWS IAM has launched Access Troubleshooter, a new feature that provides visibility into the full authorization context behind access denied errors. The tool eliminates trial-and-error debugging by allowing developers to inspect the complete authorization chain when access is denied.

top_stories.title: Microsoft’s Agent Framework PyPI package compromised to steal credentials
top_stories.summary: Hackers compromised Microsoft's official Agent Framework Python package on PyPI, publishing malicious versions designed to steal cloud credentials and sensitive information from developers' systems. The supply chain attack targeted developers using Microsoft's Agent Framework, with the malicious packages specifically designed to exfiltrate cloud credentials.

news.title: Rubrik Configuration Resilience rolls back unauthorized Microsoft 365 changes
news.summary: Rubrik launched Configuration Resilience for Microsoft 365, a product that monitors and rolls back unauthorized changes to Microsoft 365, Purview, and Defender configurations with a single action. The offering is part of Rubrik Security Cloud and covers recovery of identity, configuration, and data for Microsoft 365 environments.

news.title: Bitwarden expands passkey support with new Windows and macOS integrations
news.summary: Bitwarden has expanded passkey support with native integrations for Windows and macOS, enabling users to unlock their vaults via Windows Hello or Apple Touch ID. The update also allows Windows 11 and macOS to recognize Bitwarden as a passkey provider, letting users create and store passkeys directly in their Bitwarden vault.

news.title: Major Brazilian Signature Apps Enable RCE & Fraud
news.summary: Brazilian government-sanctioned digital signature authentication middleware applications contain remote code execution (RCE) vulnerabilities and fraud-enabling bugs. The flaws affect software used to authenticate exceptionally important legal documents, creating significant risks in the country's official digital identity and signing infrastructure.

news.title: From Deepfakes to Helpdesk Impersonation: Why Stronger Verification Matters
news.summary: Specops Software published an analysis examining real-world attacks involving deepfakes, helpdesk impersonation, and fake IT support requests used to bypass identity verification. The piece focuses on how stronger identity verification methods can help organizations defend against social engineering threats targeting corporate access controls.

news.title: New Attack Bypasses TPM Lockout to Crack Windows Hello and BitLocker PINs in Days, Not Years
news.summary: Researchers at Technische Universität Berlin discovered an attack that bypasses TPM lockout mechanisms on AMD-based and some Intel PCs, allowing brute-force cracking of Windows Hello and BitLocker PINs within days. The attack requires physical access to open the device case, enabling the attacker to reset the lockout counter and guess short PINs, with lab tests successfully recovering a four-digit Windows Hello PIN and a six-digit BitLocker PIN.

news.title: Java4Shell Flaw (CVE-2026-114938) Enables Pre-Auth RCE in Jira, Jenkins, Keycloak and More
news.summary: A Java vulnerability dubbed Java4Shell (CVE-2026-114938) enables pre-authentication remote code execution in widely used applications including Keycloak, Jira, and Jenkins. The flaw exists in Java 17.0.6 and later, running only on x86-64 Intel and AMD chips supporting the AVX-512 VBMI feature, with Keycloak's inclusion making it directly relevant to IAM deployments.

news.title: Russian COLD RELIC Hackers Use Stolen Google Workspace Data to Breach Second U.S. Organization
news.summary: Russian cyber espionage group COLD RELIC (formerly COLDRIVER/UNC4057) used stolen Google Workspace data from one compromised U.S. organization to breach a second organization. The attack chain involved leveraging cloud identity credentials and workspace access as a launchpad for linked intrusions, as investigated by Google's Mandiant and Threat Intelligence Group.

news.title: AWS IAM account access manager is now even easier to deploy and use
news.summary: AWS has updated its IAM account access manager with new features to simplify deployment and administration. The updates include support for AWS managed policies, infrastructure-as-code (IaC) integration, and improvements to role assignment workflows.

news.title: Cloud keys leaked in Docker Hub images are stolen within seconds
news.summary: Attackers are stealing credentials and access secrets exposed in public Docker Hub images within seconds of publication, with exploitation occurring as fast as eight seconds after a secret is leaked. The research highlights the automated scanning infrastructure used by threat actors to harvest cloud keys, API tokens, and other access credentials from publicly accessible container images.

news.title: Apple Tightens macOS App Permissions to Limit Data Access Amid AI Agent Security Risks
news.summary: Apple is introducing more granular app permission controls in macOS 26 beta 2, affecting Device Control, Data Access, and Full Disk Access APIs. The changes are partly motivated by AI agent security risks and aim to give users more transparency over what data applications can access.

news.title: Secure OAuth patterns for Snowflake Cortex AI through Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
news.summary: AWS published a technical walkthrough of three OAuth authentication patterns for connecting Amazon Bedrock AgentCore to Snowflake Cortex AI via MCP, tested using AgentCore Identity. The patterns covered include Snowflake-native OAuth, three-legged OAuth with a corporate identity provider, and two-legged OAuth for service-to-service authentication.

news.title: Securing REST APIs with JWT authorizers in Amazon API Gateway
news.summary: Amazon API Gateway has added native JWT authorizer support for REST APIs, enabling token validation from any OIDC-compatible identity provider without requiring a Lambda authorizer. The feature supports machine-to-machine authentication flows using standard JWT/OIDC protocols directly within the API Gateway layer.

news.title: Semperis updates Lightning identity security platform to defend against AI agent attacks
news.summary: Semperis has released an updated version of its Lightning identity security platform, specifically designed to defend against AI agent-based identity attacks. The update targets enterprise identity protection and cyber resilience use cases, expanding the platform's capabilities to address emerging AI-driven threats.

news.title: Airlock Digital blocks unauthorized AI agent actions at the endpoint
news.summary: Airlock Digital released version 7.1 of its software, introducing "Agentic Control" to manage and restrict AI agent actions at the endpoint. The feature extends the vendor's Deny by Default Application Control framework to govern AI agent behavior.

news.title: How Modern PAM Secures the AI Agents That Password Vaults Can’t
news.summary: The article examines how modern Privileged Access Management (PAM) solutions address security challenges posed by AI agents, which traditional password vaults cannot adequately protect. It covers specific PAM capabilities including just-in-time access provisioning, least-privilege controls, activity monitoring, and real-time intervention mechanisms for AI agent environments.

news.title: Okta Review 2026: Pricing, Pros & Cons
news.summary: A review of Okta's identity platform covers pricing starting at $6 per user per month across five plans. The review focuses on use cases for IT and HR teams managing joiner, mover, and leaver access workflows from HR systems.

news.title: Okta Pricing 2026: Plans & Cost per User
news.summary: An article outlines Okta's 2026 pricing structure, detailing plans including Starter, Core Essentials, and Essentials tiers starting at $6 per user per month. The breakdown includes per-headcount costs and additional fees across the available plan tiers.

news.title: NIST Finalizes Post-Quantum Cryptography Guidance, GAO Offers a Reality Check
news.summary: NIST has finalized its post-quantum cryptography guidance as GAO released a report showing federal agencies are behind in implementing quantum-resistant defenses. Post-quantum cryptography directly impacts IAM systems, as current encryption underpinning authentication protocols and identity infrastructure faces potential compromise from quantum computing.

news.title: Extortion Group Luna Moth Flits Into Law Firms a Second Time
news.summary: The Luna Moth extortion group is targeting law firms using social engineering attacks designed to steal Microsoft access tokens. The campaign specifically retargets organizations that previously refused to pay ransoms, focusing on credential and token theft as the primary attack vector.

news.title: Microsoft Fixes Nearly 1,100 Security Vulnerabilities
news.summary: Microsoft released a Patch Tuesday update addressing nearly 1,100 security vulnerabilities, including 63 critical flaws. The update includes a zero-day vulnerability in Microsoft Outlook, alongside security updates from Adobe, Apple, Google, and Mozilla.
